description: Read a shared tool's kind and redacted spec -- only works when the owner shared it with expose_spec: true. The spec never carries env values or secret references (see host.tool_share's expose_spec).

tenant_key.description: The key `signup` returned. Required only when this connection carries no Authorization: Bearer header -- when both are present, the header wins. Omitting it on a connection with no header returns tenant_key_missing (-32602).

tool.description: "<owner_namespace>.<name>", the same qualified name host.tool_call uses for a shared tool.

name: host.tool_spec_shared
